# Code of conduct

Pinguin Survivors is an open source game project: people contribute code, art feedback, balance reports, translations and bug reports. This code of conduct applies to every project space: the GitHub repository (issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews), the Steam community hub and store page discussions, and any other channel run for the project.

It is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/), version 2.1.

## Our pledge

We want participation in Pinguin Survivors to be free of harassment for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Expected behaviour

- Be respectful and kind, including when you disagree about a balance change, a design decision or a pull request.
- Criticise ideas and work, not people; give and accept constructive feedback.
- Report bugs with steps to reproduce, version and platform; report balance issues with data when you have it.
- Accept responsibility for mistakes, apologise to those affected and learn from them.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Harassment, insults, slurs, threats, or sexualised language or imagery.
- Personal attacks, trolling and deliberately inflammatory comments.
- Publishing someone's private information without explicit permission.
- Spam, review bombing, cheating tools aimed at leaderboards, or coordinated campaigns.
- Posting copyrighted material (including the game's proprietary assets) without permission.
- Any other conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Enforcement

The maintainer clarifies and enforces these standards and may remove or edit comments, commits, issues and other contributions that break this code of conduct, and may warn, temporarily restrict or permanently ban a contributor.

| Impact | Usual action |
| --- | --- |
| Inappropriate language or unwelcome behaviour | A private, written warning explaining the problem |
| A single serious violation or repeated behaviour | A warning with consequences and a temporary restriction from interaction |
| Sustained inappropriate behaviour or harassment | A temporary ban |
| A pattern of violations, harassment of a person, or aggression toward groups | A permanent ban |

## Reporting

Report a problem to the maintainer through the e-mail listed on the [maintainer's GitHub profile](https://github.com/AlexGalhardo) with "Code of conduct" in the subject, or through a private GitHub message. Reports are handled promptly and confidentially; reporters are not retaliated against.
